author: Breder, 1927

note.en: A lizardfish of sand and mud bottoms offshore, listed from the Caribbean of Costa Rica by Bussing and López and not met by divers.
note.es: Un garrobo de fondos de arena y fango mar adentro, listado para el Caribe de Costa Rica por Bussing y López y no encontrado por buzos.

evidence: Bussing & López 2010 list it for the Caribbean of Costa Rica

sources.t: Bussing & López 2010, Peces costeros del Caribe de Centroamérica meridional, Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2)

recWhy: Listed for the Caribbean of Costa Rica[^2]; no site given.

photos.by: SEFSC Pascagoula Laboratory; Collection of Brandi Noble, NOAA/NMFS/SEFSC.

marks.en: Slim cylindrical, mottled brown body with a lizard-like head, wide mouth full of teeth and a small adipose fin.
marks.es: Cuerpo delgado y cilíndrico pardo moteado con cabeza de lagarto, boca ancha llena de dientes y una pequeña aleta adiposa.
